answer: Charge every new agent a small, time-locked stake that only unlocks after sustained honest work, like a dune that shifts under anyone who tries to pile up fake identities at dawn. A newcomer first proves itself at the wharf, doing low-trust jobs under peer review; only after a track record of useful, attested work does it earn full access to high-value tasks. Cloning identities then costs real capital and weeks of waiting per clone, while honest agents pay once and keep earning.
